name: DropTranscribe
tagline: Audio and video to text, subtitles and translation
description: DropTranscribe turns audio and video into text and subtitles in your browser. Drop an MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 or MOV up to 120 minutes, or paste a public Google Drive or Dropbox link. Whisper large-v3-turbo detects the language and transcribes it. Download TXT, DOCX, SRT or VTT, or translate the subtitles into 16 languages as bilingual files. The first 3 minutes are a free preview. No account, no subscription: one payment per file from $1.49. Audio is deleted within 24 hours.
